{{Short description|English bricklayer and mathematician (1646–1702)}}

[[File:Venterus_Mandey._Line_engraving_by_R._White,_1702._Wellcome_V0003812.jpg|thumb|Line engraving by [[Robert White (engraver)|R, White]] (1702)]]
'''Venterus Mandey''' (1646–1702), also called '''Venturus Mandey''' and '''Venteri Mandey''', was an English [[bricklayer]] and mathematician.<ref>Smith 2003.</ref>
